title: Device Evaluation Authorization
text: I confirm that I own the device described in this request or have the owner’s permission to request service. I authorize GotCracked to inspect and diagnose this device. GotCracked will explain the proposed billable repair and price for my approval before proceeding. If the proposed work changes, GotCracked will contact me for approval. I understand that I should back up important information if possible and tell the team if protecting or recovering data is my priority. I will discuss any necessary device access directly with staff, rather than sending passwords or passcodes through this form. I agree to use an electronic signature for this authorization and to receive an electronic record. I can ask the shop for a paper authorization instead.
